focusedCoreBinding.algorithm: sha256-path-length-content over the six files enumerated below

sourceBinding.bindingBoundary: This digest covers the implementation and focused tests named above. It does not reuse or silently amend the earlier linguistics verification, working-tree status, or release binding.

inWorldNarrator: NightDebrief now says what the house kept moving, the played night, and by closing time.
The fiction boundary identifies CHORUS as fiction and names this night without simulation, model, engine, game, generated-output, runtime, player, or authored-production narration.

The bounded negative safety proposition 'does not diagnose, predict, assess, measure, or score real people or you' is retained. Its use of score denies an assessment output; it is not a scoring frame.
Malformed completed records remain inside the house and refuse to tell a story from an unverifiable record.
statusPresentation: Visible labels are Played, Experienced, and Encountered.
Each label has an adjacent direct gloss while the typed lower-case status and its provenance remain unchanged.
Played says that the action matched a concept without claiming that its intended effect followed; Experienced says that a matching change occurred without claiming that it was chosen or agreed with.
sceneBeforeInterpretation: The concrete artifact and public disclosure still precede the first decision and the concept receipt.
Crossover records name the incident material as a claim about the incident place and state the concrete unresolved limit before asking which repeated copies retained those limits.
The abstract pressure sentence 'this seat's role carries trust' is excluded when it would displace a concrete scene fact.
causalAndCarrierBoundaries: Direct content and direct format routes use typed carriers; ambient routes explicitly deny carriage.
When a chosen message or presentation did not cross, any attribution, ranking, trust, workload, language, or other background change is named separately.
Aggregate afterimages no longer invent posts, copies, accounts, an outbound source, or a particular carrier from a room-level delta.
Aggregate Crossover residue names only a path for material and immediately states that the path does not prove that any particular message or belief crossed.
beneficiariesAndCosts: Every selected last resort retains the positive consequence, protected party, harmed party with harm, and the acting seat's self-cost.
Repeated choice labels remain separate events with independent decision and cost provenance.
closingProofBoundary: Every changed afterimage produces a resolution, a metric-specific residue, and a separately typed reflection atom with the same source.
The no-change branch produces a sourced no-net-change residue and states that the absence does not settle the account or make it true.
The reflection is direction-neutral as proof: rising and falling variants describe different movement, but neither sign proves more than the typed metric supports.
generatorCompatibility: A pre-commit byte audit found that the in-world correction changed generated Crossover and signaling-observable copy while the generator identifier still said version 14.
That failed compatibility state was corrected by advancing the authored model to version 15; version-13 and version-14 saves now fail closed before trace replay.
Version-salted copy fixtures, simulation evidence, publications, and current-source bindings are regenerated for version 15 rather than relabeling version-14 evidence.

metrics.reach: More or fewer people seeing material does not prove belief or truth.
metrics.crossover: An easier or harder path for material does not prove that a particular message or belief crossed.
metrics.provenance: More or less source context does not prove that a particular copy moved or stopped.
metrics.verification: More or less support for checking does not prove that anyone checked or changed a belief.
metrics.heat: More heated or calmer reactions do not prove belief or cause.
metrics.blame: Rising or falling blame does not prove responsibility.
metrics.belief: Stronger or weaker acceptance does not prove truth.
metrics.consensus: A wider or narrower appearance of agreement does not prove shared belief or truth.
metrics.trust: Rising or falling trust does not prove truth or source trustworthiness.
metrics.coordination: Rising or easing pressure to coordinate does not prove agreement or shared purpose.
metrics.commonGround: Clearer or harder-to-see shared action does not prove shared motive, language, or belief; when a concrete shared action is named, its communication record is a co-source.

directionNeutralProofBoundaries.zeroChange: No later net change does not settle the account or make it true.
directionNeutralProofBoundaries.adversarialResult: All 11 metrics in both directions preserve exact residue, reflection, and source assertions in the strengthened copy contract.

materialNamedCrossover.sceneRecord: The Crossover artifact now names the repeated claim about the incident's place noun and includes the exact unresolved-at-entry limit.
materialNamedCrossover.sceneQuestion: The following question asks which repeated copies kept those already stated limits visible instead of referring to an unexplained unresolved claim or source uncertainty.
materialNamedCrossover.aggregateAfterimageBoundary: A room-level Crossover delta cannot identify a specific carrier; the ending therefore says only that the path for material became easier or harder and refuses to infer a particular message or belief.
evidence: tests/copy-contract.test.mjs scene-first and targeted Crossover proof-boundary contracts

findingDispositions.correction: All Summary-owned static strings, generated natural prose, concept evidence, status copy, recovery copy, and fiction-boundary copy are scanned without simulat*; the persistent header now says social trust fiction.

The accessible boundary is named Fiction boundary; generated-night, model-limit, authored-production, and score-report framing were removed. The bounded words 'does not ... score real people or you' remain solely as a negative safety proposition.
Played, Experienced, and Encountered are visible with direct adjacent glosses; the underlying typed statuses and provenance remain unchanged.
The heading is now 'What the house kept moving.', matching the bounded movement selected by the narrative rather than claiming an exhaustive list of all changes.

The ending attaches a metric-specific, direction-neutral proof boundary to every changed residue and an explicit truth boundary to the zero-change branch. All 22 metric-direction combinations now have targeted assertions.
Played concept copy names action design, while completed carriage and other changes require matching typed receipts and remain separate evidence propositions.
Exposure/cognition, motive/character, concept/outcome, metric/truth, and status/provenance distinctions are enforced by generated-path and targeted branch tests.
Carriers remain typed and source-bound; room-level afterimages no longer invent outbound material. Last-resort beneficiaries and cost bearers remain separately sourced and recoverable.
Ambient blame and other background changes are introduced separately after explicit non-carriage; later decisions remain chronological rather than being narrated as caused replies.

Concrete scene atoms carry proof independently of the house metaphor, and metric-specific reflections state a distinct false-inference boundary instead of repeating 'the night records' or 'what movement could not prove'.
